description: This file defines a CheckList node for a rich text editor, including its HTML rendering, input rules, commands, and keyboard shortcuts, as part of the Notesnook project.

classes.name: CheckList
classes.description: A Tiptap Node extension representing a checklist, with options for rendering, input rules, commands, and shortcuts.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the checklist node, such as item type name and HTML attributes.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Defines how to parse HTML elements into this checklist node.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render this checklist node as HTML.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Adds command functions, including toggleCheckList, to toggle the checklist.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules for automatically converting text patterns into checklist items.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Defines keyboard shortcuts for toggling the checklist.
